ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and domestic Vanuatu sanctions screening. All UBOs, directors, and beneficial owners must be screened through the VFSC AML database and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU). Negative news and adverse media screening is required under the 2014 AML/CFT Act. High-Risk_Special_License designation triggers enhanced due diligence and senior management approval.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Name Reservation Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Name must be in Latin script (English); any non-English name must be submitted with a certified English transliteration. The name, common seal, and publication must not confuse or mislead as to nationality, business, or government endorsement. The statutory suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' is mandatory for International Companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may apply in writing to the VFSC Registrar of Companies for an administrative review within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must state legal and factual grounds, provide a corrected name or supporting consent (e.g., ministerial approval), and be accompanied by the VFSC prescribed fee (approx. US$150). If the reconsideration is declined, the applicant may file a civil claim in the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for high-risk nutraceuticals e-commerce structures. The registered office and physical presence requirement under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and the AML/CFT Act require a compile local registered agent and a real operational office with such access or correspondence. Virtual office is not accepted for high-risk merchant account approval, KYC, or VFSC regulatory oversight.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced physical on-site inspections is 45% within the first 12 months of incorporation, given the 'High_Risk_Special_License' classification, the ISIC 4791 online retail scope, and the requirement for corporate substance in Vanuatu.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Vanuatu International Companies Act No. 32 of 2011, sections 2, 5(2), 7, 11, 12 and 19; VFSC (International Companies) Regulations 2012
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry and Corporate Registries Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow deposit requirement; an International Company may issue shares without par value and allot shares fully paid or partly paid as resolved by the board; VFSC requires the licensed registered agent to retain beneficial ownership records.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED THAT: (i) the subscribers to the Memorandum accept the initial ordinary shares allotted to the founding shareholder as recorded in the share register, and that no share premium is payable; (ii) the registered office of the Company in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, as specified by the registered agent and filed in the incorporation application, is adopted; (iii) the shareholders confirm the appointment of [FULL NAME] as first director, and the board appoints [FULL NAME] as corporate secretary and chief compliance officer; (iv) the execution and lodgement with the VFSC of this resolution and all ancillary governance instruments be and is hereby authorised.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name pre-clearance and entity classification confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – VFSC Online Client Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent logs in to the VFSC client portal and lodges a name availability and pre-clearance application. The proposed name must end with 'Limited' or 'International Company' and must not contain regulated words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance' or 'Reinsurance' without a separate licence. The business activity summary must confirm internet retail of dietary supplements and nutraceuticals as a non-financial commercial activity. VFSC issues a name clearance letter before the full incorporation application is submitted.
required_dossiers: Two proposed company names
Copy of passport of each subscriber
Proof of residential address of each subscriber (utility bill or bank statement)
Business activity description under ISIC 4791
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as unavailable, misleading, or contrary to public policy, the registered agent selects the alternate name and refiles the pre-clearance within five business days; the first single re-application is processed without additional substantive fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent (corporate services provider), Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association, the share register, the registered office confirmation, and the consents of the first directors. Each subscriber executes the constitutional documents before a notary public or another person authorised under the International Companies Act. The registered agent certifies the copies and schedules execution of Form IC-01 once all signatures and due diligence material are complete.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as registered agent
Consent of first directors
Certified copies of passports and proof of address
Notarized signatures of all subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC or the registered agent queries a signature or consent, the affected document is re-executed and resubmitted within ten business days; the registered agent supervises a fresh notarial acknowledgement before lodgement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory incorporation application and issuance of certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – filing counter and e-portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files Form IC-01 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent's consent, and the prescribed incorporation fee of USD 350. The VFSC review officer verifies compliance with the International Companies Act, registers the International Company, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation and certified copies of constitutional documents. After registration, the registered agent completes the internal customer due diligence file and opens the statutory record.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01 signed by the registered agent
Original or certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered agent consent and office confirmation
Proof of payment of VFSC incorporation fee
Director and shareholder declarations under the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent notifies the applicant in writing and corrects the identified omissions within fourteen days without penalty. A refusal on public policy grounds may be appealed in writing to the Deputy Commissioner of Financial Services.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Formal board meeting, share subscription and officer appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the International Company, Port Vila, acting through the first directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding shareholder and the first directors convene the initial board meeting. The board approves the pro-forma First Board Resolution, adopts the share register, issues share certificates to the founding shareholder, confirms the registered office address, and appoints the corporate secretary and chief compliance officer. Minutes are executed and maintained at the registered office in physical or electronic form.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma First Board Resolution
Minutes of the initial meeting of directors
Share register and share certificates
Consent to act as director or secretary
Registered office address record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director or shareholder dissents or a statutory consent is missing, a written resolution of all directors and shareholders is circulated and approved within five business days; record the notice, abstention or approval in the minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Governance record finalisation and complementary commercial licence initiation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Vanuatu Ministry of Health, and the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The statutory registers are finalised, beneficial ownership records are maintained at the registered agent, and the VFSC annual return timeline is created. Because cross-border online retail of nutraceuticals is classified as high-risk for anti-money laundering purposes, the company must obtain a municipal business licence, register with the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue if goods pass through Vanuatu, and apply for a Health Products Retail and Import Licence before the first commercial transaction is processed.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Beneficial ownership declaration
VFSC annual return schedule
Health Products Retail and Import Licence application
Municipal business licence application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If licensing is deferred pending inspection, the company may continue only under a signed provisional administrative authorisation where the relevant Ministry expressly permits it; any objection is cured by addressing the inspection finding and resubmitting the application through the Ministry's appeals channel before the first saleable inventory is distributed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Health – Drugs and Therapeutics Unit, in coordination with the Vanuatu Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce and the VFSC
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Pharmaceutical and Nutraceutical Import and Retail Business Licence issued under the Vanuatu Medicines and Cosmetics Act (as amended) and applicable import control regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC) – Environmental Protection and Conservation Act [Cap. 283]
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration (Category B – low-impact storage, order fulfilment and courier staging facility; no full Environmental Impact Statement required unless warehousing area exceeds 500 m² or cold storage uses ozone-depleting refrigerants).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Comply with Vanuatu Water Quality Standards for domestic discharge: BOD ≤ 30 mg/L and total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L; maintain hazardous waste and pharmaceutical waste records; no VOC-emitting coating or manufacturing equipment on site; implement spill containment, pest control, tamper-evident packaging and temperature control logs to preserve supplement integrity; export batteries, e-waste and used refrigerants only through authorised recyclers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services Brigade fire safety certificate for storage areas and exits; Public Works Department structural load inspection for racking and mezzanine installations; Ministry of Health occupational health clearance for temperature-controlled handling of nutraceuticals; and VFSC registered-agent due diligence clearance for high-risk AML/CTF compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu maintains no national income tax authority because no corporate or personal income tax statute is in force. Fiscal and corporate governance is allocated as follows: (a) Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC, www.vfsc.vu) - sole registrar and regulator of International Companies (IC), responsible for incorporation, annual renewal, beneficial ownership filings and economic substance supervision; (b) Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management), operating the ASYCUDA World electronic customs system, customs duties, excise and Multiple Purpose Levy (MPL) on qualifying imports; (c) Municipal councils of Port Vila and Luganville - domestic business license fees, from which ICs are statutorily exempt.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No national TIN or VAT identification number is issued in Vanuatu because no income tax or VAT law exists. A foreign-owned IC obtains its fiscal identity as follows: (1) engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent (mandatory statutory requirement); (2) file the Memorandum and Articles of Association and Certificate of Incorporation application with the VFSC registry; (3) receive the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the IC registration number, typically within 1-3 business days upon payment of the VFSC statutory government fee plus registered agent fees; (4) maintain the mandatory registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu; (5) pay the annual VFSC renewal fee to preserve the tax exemption; (6) file beneficial ownership details and any economic substance returns when triggered; (7) if physical goods cross the Vanuatu border, obtain a VRCA Customs client code and file export/import entries in ASYCUDA World. No municipal business license is required for an IC, and no revenue authority tax file number is assigned.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Vanuatu operates no check-the-box election, no hybrid mismatch election, and no statutory mechanism to waive, limit or opt into taxation. Tax status is fixed by the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: an IC is exempt from all Vanuatu taxes, duties, imposts and charges, including income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty, business license fees and land transfer tax, irrespective of ownership, turnover or place of management. The IC must not carry on business with Vanuatu residents and must not hold Vanuatu land or licensed banking/insurance activities without separate authorization; cross-border nutraceutical e-commerce sales to non-residents do not disturb the exemption. No U.S.-style entity classification or hybrid translocation election exists in Vanuatu law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None - Vanuatu has no VAT, GST or sales-and-use tax system in force. Indirect fiscal levies are limited to customs import duties, excise on specified goods, and the Multiple Purpose Levy (MPL) on qualifying physical imports into Vanuatu; none apply to export sales of dietary supplements or nutraceuticals by a Vanuatu International Company.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists because no VAT/GST law is enacted. An IC is exempt from all indirect taxation regardless of turnover. Domestic traders become liable for municipal business license fees from the first vatu (VUV) of local turnover, but s.77 of the International Companies Act expressly disapplies such fees for ICs in good standing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu imposes no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, continuous transaction control, or digital stamping obligation. Physical exports are cleared through the ASYCUDA World electronic customs declaration system administered by VRCA; invoices issued by an IC for offshore nutraceutical sales are not subject to any Vanuatu fiscal e-reporting or digital validation requirement.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - Vanuatu imposes no VAT/GST on domestic sales, exports, or offshore services, so there is no export zero-rating claim or refund mechanism to assert. Cross-border nutraceutical sales by the IC sit entirely outside the Vanuatu indirect tax base; no export equalization levy, turnover-based export tax, or stamp duty applies. Customs duties and the Multiple Purpose Levy are chargeable only on physical imports into Vanuatu territory, never on outbound shipments, digital supplies, or offshore card-not-present transactions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic entry), required only if physical goods are shipped from Vanuatu territory
Commercial invoice identifying the exporting IC, consignee, product description and HS codes
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Certificate of Origin, where required by the destination jurisdiction's customs authority
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and current annual renewal certificate evidencing IC tax-exempt status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT export-fraud clawback regime exists because no VAT is imposed. Enforcement risk concentrates on corporate and customs compliance: (1) VFSC annual renewal default triggers statutory late penalties, loss of good standing and potential strike-off; (2) failure to maintain a registered agent or beneficial ownership records exposes the IC to fines and director liability; (3) prohibited trading with Vanuatu residents can cause forfeiture of the IC exemption, retroactive municipal license fee assessments and director personal liability; (4) false customs declarations attract fines and imprisonment under the Customs Act [Cap. 121], plus seizure of goods; (5) default on economic substance obligations for relevant activities may trigger penalties and cancellation of the IC certificate. Vanuatu has no exchange control law and therefore imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day reference reflects standard high-risk merchant acquirer settlement and rolling-reserve cycles applicable to nutraceutical card-not-present payment processing.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), acting under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [CAP 124] and the Exchange Control Act [CAP 51]; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) supervises AML/CFT compliance for all authorized dealers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is a floating currency with current-account convertibility consistent with Vanuatu's IMF Article VIII status (accepted 1981); there are no statutory restrictions on dividends, interest, or profit remittance by International Companies. Practically, fund transfers are routed through authorized dealers with documentary proof of legitimate source of funds, and a bank-level source-of-funds review is mandatory under the AML/CFT regime. Capital-account flows are liberalized for ICs, but the RBV requires statistical declaration forms for cross-border investment transactions. No withholding tax is imposed on outbound dividends in Vanuatu, though the high-risk nature of nutraceutical e-commerce triggers enhanced due diligence and possible de-risking by correspondent banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act [CAP 51], export proceeds from the sale of goods must be received through an authorized dealer in Vanuatu within 6 months of the date of shipment. There is no mandatory conversion ratio to VUV; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in a foreign-currency account at a licensed commercial bank. The exporter must submit a completed Form EX-1 (Exchange Control Declaration), a customs export declaration, sales invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, and proof of receipt within the prescribed window. Failure to comply may result in enforcement action by the RBV under exchange control regulations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Currency Operational Account + USD Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Settlement and Merchant Settling Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium feasibility. Vanuatu has no dedicated Electronic Money Institution (EMI) license framework comparable to the FCA or MAS; the VFSC Financial Dealers License covers only limited dealing activity, not a full EMI passport. Offshore digital EMI providers must either partner with a Tier 1 Vanuatu bank as a sponsor or rely on an unrestricted foreign license, which most VU banks will reject under de-risking policies. The RBV does not issue EMI authorizations, and the absence of a national payment systems sandbox further constrains fintech-only clearing in VUV. Viability is acceptable only as a secondary e-wallet layer, not as the primary treasury rail.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is generally permitted by private banks (ANZ, BSP, BRED) on a risk-based approach, but for the High_Risk_Special_License category of nutraceutical e-commerce, banks normally impose a physical board-level interview in Port Vila or a video interview with independent notarization of director identity held at a VFSC-registered agent. NBV consistently requires physical attendance of directors. A resident agent identification certificate and original or certified copies of passport, proof of address, and beneficial ownership declaration are mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity and nominee shareholder structure of the International Company
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incumbency issued by the VFSC-licensed registered agent listing all ultimate beneficial owners and the controlling trust/corporate chain; signed shareholder declaration; updated VU registry extract; notarized declaration of non-nominee status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk pharmaceutical/nutraceutical product line triggering ML typologies of over/under-invoicing and chargeback fraud
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid Vanuatu business license; health-supplement registration or VFSC special license; full third-party supplier contracts with itemized pricing; batch certificates of analysis; letters of guarantee or free-sale certificates; live e-commerce website demonstrating real commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds for initial escrow or shareholder capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 6-12 months of original bank statements from personal/professional accounts; wealth-source affidavit executed by a commissioner of oaths; audited financial statements or certified tax returns of the beneficial owner; explanation memorandum covering accumulation of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Reputational concern from Vanuatu citizenship-by-investment programs (passport sales) being perceived as high-risk nationality exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original passport of dominant nationality; proof of physical residency and economic nexus (e.g., rental agreements, employment contracts, company incorporation records); declaration that no Vanuatu CIP passport in connection with unexplained funds is used.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent banking de-risking of VUV cross-border rails due to low transaction volume and international sanctions screening complexity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed transactional forecast with average ticket sizes below threshold triggers; confirm payment counterparties' KYC documentation; commitment letter to pre-validate customers; compliance attestation signed by an external AML consultant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injection routed via SWIFT MT103 to a USD or VUV operational account held with an authorized dealer in Vanuatu. The remittance purpose must be coded as 'Equity Capital Contribution' with reference to the Company's contract, a board resolution, and the VFSC registration certificate. The bank will require a completed Exchange Control Statistic Form and a source-of-funds breakdown. For loans, a written facility agreement with arm's-length interest rate is required. All inbound funds are subject to sanctions screening, confirmation of beneficial ownership, and non-PEP verification before credit. No prior RBV approval is required for ordinary equity injections; transactions exceeding VUV 100 million (approx. USD 850,000) may trigger individual bank board approval and EDD.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements are primarily (a) SWIFT MT103 direct bank transfers for high-frequency small-dollar e-commerce orders and supplier invoices, and (b) Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for large-volume pharmaceutical procurement. Authorized dealers will also execute cross-border drafts and RMB or EUR clearings via correspondent banks in Australia (ANZ, BSP) and Europe (BRED). All outbound vouchers require underlying invoices, bill of lading, purchase orders, and a declaration of ultimate destination. Merchant-acquiring settlement for credit-card sales will be routed either to a dedicated high-risk merchant account (e.g., an acquiring bank licensed in Vanuatu or a foreign sponsor with a VU IC) and then swept to the operating account via MT103/MT202. Chargeback reserve pooling is advisable given the ISO 2022 requirements for e-commerce merchants.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX spot contracts with authorized dealers in VUV/USD, VUV/AUD, and VUV/NZD
Outright VUV/USD forward contracts up to 12 months available solely through licensed domestic authorized dealers
Cross-currency swaps (VUV against USD) approved by the RBV on a case-by-case basis for documented trade flows of International Companies
Offshore NDFs referencing the VUV are not domestically permitted; only non-deliverable forward quotations from overseas banks may be used as pricing benchmarks, not as deliverable hedges

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VFSC International Company Renewal (payment of prescribed annual government fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation; no formal grace period, failure to pay by anniversary triggers late-payment penalty.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty: 10% of fee if paid within 30 days past due, 20% after 30 days; continued non-payment for 12 months leads to administrative strike-off from VFSC register and loss of corporate legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Renewal and Attestation of Statutory Registers (members, directors, charges, and UBO registers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - International Companies Registry; through licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with annual fee payment; register must remain physically available in Vanuatu at all times; annual compliance attestation filed on the anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or produce statutory registers on VFSC request may incur fines up to VUV 100,000 (approx. USD 850) plus daily continuing penalties; persistent non-compliance may trigger director disqualification and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation Statement for International Company (beneficial ownership register update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent of Vanuatu International Company; records readily available for inspection by VFSC on lawful demand.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On each anniversary of incorporation and within 30 days following any change of beneficial ownership, share transfer, or allotment.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with beneficial ownership rules under International Companies (Amendment) Act can be prosecuted with penalty of up to VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 85,000) and/or imprisonment; continued default may also lead to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act; an audit may become requirement only via a shareholder special resolution, VFSC license condition, or commercial counterparty agreement.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act does not prescribe IFRS or local GAAP; internal accounting records sufficient to reflect financial position are required; IFRS or IAS is commonly used if a voluntary audit is commissioned.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must collect and record beneficial ownership data in a confidential UBO register located in Vanuatu. On each anniversary, the beneficial owner(s) must provide a signed written confirmation that the recorded beneficial ownership remains accurate; new shareholding transfers are to be reported to the registered agent within 30 days for register updating. The UBO register is disclosed to VFSC only upon official request, not publicly.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - 1,500 per annum (standard registered agent and office service in Vanuatu, excluding renewal fee)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 - 4,000 per annum (estimated external certified audit fee if voluntarily required; no mandatory audit for exempt IC).

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies in Vanuatu are fully exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax for a renewable 20-year period under Section 119 of the International Companies Act Cap 222. The only statutory charge is the annual VFSC license fee (VUV 30,000–VUV 100,000) based on share capital. No preferential regime deductions apply because the tax base is zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is required for a Vanuatu International Company. The only recurring compliance filing is the VFSC Annual License Renewal submitted by the licensed registered agent via the VFSC Online Registry (https://www.vfsc.vu/).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No corporate income tax filing deadline exists. The VFSC license must be renewed within 12 months of the date of issue; late renewal incurs penalties. Proof of renewal is required to maintain standing to enforce contracts and protect assets.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of company name, registration number, registered agent, registered office address, authorized share capital, beneficial ownership register status, and payment of the annual VFSC license fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners and directors do not file income tax returns. The registered agent administers the renewal. The company must maintain its beneficial ownership register at the registered office and provide access to VFSC upon lawful request.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay the annual VFSC license fee exposes the company to a penalty of 10% per month or part thereof, and VFSC may strike the company off the register after a 30-day notice period, resulting in loss of legal capacity and forfeiture of actions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements. No withholding tax is imposed on dividends, so no treaty relief mechanism is required. If a foreign jurisdiction insists on a Tax Residency Certificate, the registered agent may request VFSC issuance of a Certificate of Resident Status evidencing the company’s tax-exempt status, but this is rare and non-determinative for foreign tax purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% for all outbound royalty and interest payments. In the absence of a treaty network, no reduced treaty rate applies; payments are made gross with no Vanuatu tax deducted.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File mandate, and no threshold expressed in VUV. Multinational groups must, however, comply with OECD-aligned documentation requirements of foreign parent jurisdictions (e.g., EUR 750,000 to EUR 50 million thresholds).
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations comparable to the BVI or Cayman Islands. Nevertheless, the VFSC licensing framework for online nutraceutical retail (ISIC 4791) requires demonstrable physical presence, a substantive board process, and core income-generating activities conducted from Vanuatu. Failure to maintain such substance may expose the structure to foreign anti-abuse challenges (CFC rules, economic substance recharacterization, and shell-company denial claims).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company as a paper-only entity to shift untaxed profit from the beneficial owner’s residence jurisdiction while falsely representing that Vanuatu statutory exemption legitimizes the avoidance of foreign tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The International Companies Act Cap 222 permits VFSC to strike off offending companies. Criminal prosecution for fraud may lead to fines up to VT 1,000,000, restitution orders, and forfeiture of assets through mutual legal assistance channels with foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly participate in tax evasion or misrepresentation are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes, penalties, and interest; courts may pierce the corporate veil to impose civil restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment for statutory fraud (maximum term 7 years).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Engaging in cross-border sales of dietary supplements and nutraceuticals without obtaining the mandatory High-Risk Special License from VFSC and without complying with Vanuatu’s food and pharmacy product regulations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VFSC may levy administrative fines up to VT 500,000, suspend or revoke the Special License, and prohibit further e-commerce operations. Additional penalties may be imposed under the Vanuatu Pharmacy and Medicines Act for distribution of unapproved health products.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for any fine if the unlicensed activity arises from their direction or neglect; egregious cases trigger director disqualification orders, asset freezes, and travel bans pending full compliance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain an accurate beneficial ownership register or processing high-risk credit-card transactions without conducting AML/KYC, sanctions screening, and suspicious transaction reporting as required by the Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Act (AMLTFA) 2014.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AMLTFA 2014 imposes fines on legal persons up to VT 2,000,000, license revocation, and mandatory dissolution; the Vanuatu FIU may issue freezing orders and initiate criminal prosecutions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly fail to report suspicious activity or who permit sanctions violations face personal fines up to VT 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; personal asset forfeiture and travel bans are routinely granted by the Vanuatu courts.
